location_exception_reason: Greenhouse construction is a location-dependent service; buyers need to identify service providers operating in their region/state. Location in title enables geographic filtering and reduces irrelevant inquiries from distant areas.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Contractor', 'Service Provider', 'Turnkey Builder') materially change buyer expectations: a 'Turnkey Greenhouse Contractor' implies end-to-end delivery with subsidy documentation support, whereas 'Greenhouse Contractor' alone is ambiguous about scope. The service model (design-only vs. full construction vs. subsidy-assisted) is a core product attribute, not just a seller classification.
